reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 (as amended by X3.23b-1993) identifier-1 of USE BEFORE REPORTING must reference a report group (of any TYPE, optionally qualified by its report-name), and one report group must not be named by more than one USE BEFORE REPORTING statement within the same Procedure Division, however the reference is spelled; a separate (e.g. contained) program's Procedure Division may name it again.

edition-consulted.switches: edition.DialectLevel < 2002 picks the cited rule in the COBOL1920 ambiguity message only

reader.edition-search: Read DeclBindUse's REPORTING arm (ReportGroupResolution.Resolve, the not-a-group COBOL0897, the _useReportGroups ConstructOperandRegister duplicate test keyed on the resolved ReportGroupModel) and its per-statement EndConstruct; grep for DialectLevel / Edition.Edition in ProcedureTableBuilder's USE arm finds none; the grammar's useStatement / reportGroupReference carry no version predicate.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the report-group test and the per-Procedure-Division duplicate test are one path at every edition (the amended 1985 SR2 and §2023:14.9.49.3 SR9 say the same).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise a qualified report-group operand and the report-group/data-item homonym; not the duplicate refusal, the non-group refusals, nor the same group named again in a contained program.

probes.printed: U-DET-R1 / U-DET-R2 / U-DONLY / U-CFF +0010 (detail groups qualified OF and IN, unqualified, and a control footing)
probes.expected: legal: each identifier-1 references a report group; each declarative runs before its group

probes.printed: error COBOL0897: report group 'DONLY' already has a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure in this procedure division (DONLY then DONLY OF R1)
probes.expected: refused: same identifier-1 twice in one Procedure Division

probes.printed: error COBOL0897 on 'DET' (DET OF R2 then DET IN R2)
error COBOL0897: USE BEFORE REPORTING 'WS-AMT' does not name a report group
error COBOL1920: report group 'DET' is described in more than one report description entry (ISO §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.1)
OUTER-USE / INNER-USE, report lines 005 / 006 (outer and contained program each USE BEFORE REPORTING DET of a GLOBAL report)
probes.expected: legal under the amended text (the restriction is within the same Procedure Division); each GENERATE runs its own program's declarative (§1985:X.5.6.4 GR1a)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.9.3 SR2  (4.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: Conforms. The duplicate test is keyed on the resolved group object, so differently spelled references to one group are caught. Diagnostics at --std 85 cite §2023:14.9.49.3 SR9 rather than the 1985 rule (message text only).

refuter.evidence: u1glob.cob: USE GLOBAL BEFORE REPORTING DET (the §1985:X.5.6.2 Inter-Program Communication format) then USE BEFORE REPORTING DET in one Procedure Division refused COBOL0897 'already has a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure in this procedure division' (the GLOBAL spelling does not escape the duplicate test). u2types.cob: USE BEFORE REPORTING for RH, PH (qualified OF R1), CH, CF, PF and RF groups, EXIT 0, declaratives run in order U-RH U-PH U-CH U-CF U-PF U-RF. u3wrongq.cob: DET OF R2 where DET is R1's refused COBOL0897 'does not name a report group'. The reading that 'the same identifier-1' means the same report group however spelled is the reasonable one and is what the code does. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.9.3 SR2  (4.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'; 'OK  §1985:X.5.6.2  (5.6.2 General Format)  the text is in the clause'.
